label: October 26 – November 1, 2026
intro: Halloween weekend is here, plus Book Expo and Thailand Game Show in town.
weekday_note: Weekdays are good for a quiet ice skating or Roller Dome session before the Halloween weekend crowds.

activities.title: Book Expo Thailand 2026 (final days)
activities.why: Last chance to browse kids' books, including building and superhero titles.
activities.tip: Kids' programming unconfirmed. Check the organizer first.

activities.title: gamescom asia x Thailand Game Show 2026
activities.why: Four halls of game showcases. Probably more for dad than a 5-year-old, but demo stations may suit Thor.
activities.tip: Venue and family suitability unconfirmed. Weekend crowds will be heavy.

activities.title: Wat Banthat Thong Festival "Pacha Taek"
activities.location: Banthat Thong Road, in front of Chulalongkorn University Centenary Park
activities.why: Local festival next to Centenary Park, so you can pair it with a playground and picnic stop.
activities.tip: Few details confirmed. Treat as a casual wander and check local listings.

activities.title: Chocolate Ville Spooky Town — Halloween Week
activities.why: Fun-scary Halloween village, ideal for Thor's age.
activities.tip: Weekday evenings are calmer than Halloween weekend.

activities.title: BAMBI Bangkok Halloween Party 2026
activities.location: The First & Future Steps International School, Sukhumvit Soi 31
activities.why: Costume contest, trick-or-treat parade, crafts, face painting and sensory play. Iron Man costume time!
activities.tip: Book ahead and bring the Iron Man costume.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — rollerblading & lessons
activities.why: Rollerblading is on Thor's list; instructors and free borrowed safety gear make it beginner-friendly.
activities.tip: Go early, it gets hot; some instructors speak limited English.

activities.title: Sub Zero Ice Skate Club — daytime sessions
activities.location: Sub Zero, Ekkamai / Major Cineplex Sukhumvit
activities.price: About 100 THB kids / 200 THB adults (weekday, per one guide)
activities.why: Cheap weekday ice skating, quiet before the evening club crowd.
activities.tip: Evenings turn into a nightclub, so stick to daytime. Confirm prices.

activities.title: The Rink at CentralWorld — kids' beginner lessons
activities.price: About 260 THB for a 90-minute session incl. skates (older guide)
activities.why: Smaller rink with 'practice penguins' to help young beginners balance.
activities.tip: Prices from an undated guide; check before going.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.why: Two-hour campaign with Iron Man and a Stark Mobile Lab zone: top pick for an Iron Man fan.
activities.tip: Information is older; confirm it is still open and the ticket price first.

activities.title: Thai Toys exhibition — Children's Discovery Museum
activities.date: Any day (year-long from March 2026, unconfirmed end date)
activities.why: Hands-on science through traditional toys, a good building-and-making fit.
activities.tip: End date is inferred, so check the museum page.
